resources.string: Back up your photos and videos to your private Storage Box.
Enter your Storage Box password once. PiffBackup will install a dedicated key, then erase the password without saving it.
Existing top-level folder, using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, or hyphen
Dedicated key verified for %1$s. Existing backup folder %2$s was found without changing it.
PiffBackup will stop if this server identity changes. You can compare it with the fingerprint shown by Hetzner.
Verifying the key and existing backup folder…
Check the username, server address, backup folder, and password.
Couldn’t reach the Storage Box. In Hetzner Console, enable SSH Support and External Reachability, wait a few minutes, then retry.
The Storage Box rejected that username or password. Check them and retry.
The server identity changed. PiffBackup stopped to protect your backup. Verify the fingerprint in Hetzner Console before changing this connection.
The password worked, but the dedicated key could not be installed. Retry after confirming SSH Support is enabled.
The dedicated key could not reconnect securely. No backup was started.
Connected securely, but the selected backup folder was not found. Nothing was created or changed.
The protected connection could not be saved on this device. No backup was started.
PiffBackup needs access to files you choose so its backup tool can read them directly. It cannot open other apps’ private data.
Folder access is required before continuing
Couldn’t load these Storage Box folders. Check the connection and retry.
%1$s items are already backed up\n%2$s items need uploading\n%3$s to upload
Nothing has been uploaded yet. Review the totals before starting.
The existing folders were adopted successfully. Check for new files whenever you want to run another backup.
Check the selected phone and Storage Box folders. Folders cannot overlap.
Allow folder access before checking the backup.
The existing backup could not be checked safely. Nothing was uploaded.
The folder setup changed. Check the existing backup again.
The backup stopped before completion. The successful checkpoint was not advanced; retry is safe.
Backup cancelled. The successful checkpoint was not advanced.
Protected backup state was unavailable. No successful checkpoint was recorded.
